New Graduate Students: Next Steps
New Graduate Students: Next Steps
Congratulations!
We are so excited that you are attending Delaware State University!
We can’t wait to meet you at New Graduate Student Virtual Orientation before Fall 2026 classes begin.
ORIENTATION REGISTRATION
Please click the link below to view the Fall 2026 dates and register for New Graduate Student Virtual Orientation.
Register for Orientation
NEXT STEPS FOR ENROLLMENT
Before orientation, we would like to provide you with a quick guide for the Next Steps for enrollment at Delaware State University.
Set Up Your MyDESU and Email Accounts
Visit my.desu.edu and click on the Email icon.
Email address: xxxxx22 [at] students.desu.edu | Default password: student identification number followed by #delstate e.g. D12345678#delstate (Please note: If your DSU email address was not on your acceptance letter, please send an email to gradstudieswilm [at] desu.edu.)(Please note if you are a continuing Delaware State University student your email will remain the same)
E-communication from the University will only be sent to your University-assigned email account. It is important that you monitor this email account regularly and/or link this email to your personal email account so that you do not miss any correspondence from our offices.
Contact Your Program Director
Register for Classes (step-by-step instructions)
Secure Funding – File your FAFSA
To determine your financial aid eligibility, file your FAFSA as soon as possible. Include Delaware State University’s school code – 001428. Please visit desu.edu/financialaid for more information.
Obtain documented financial support from your Program Director (find your specific program).
Confirm All Requested Application Documents Have Been Received (Please refer to your Letter of Admission for additional information.)
Letters of Recommendation
Official Transcript
Personal Statement
Test Scores (waived for COVID-19)
Resume
Pay Tuition and Fees (tuition and fee information)
Submit Your Health Form
Register to Gain Access to the William C. Jason Library (Library Patron Registration Form)
View Library Tutorials
Library Registration
Tour of the Library
Take a Moment to View Our Virtual New Student Orientation Videos, a self-guided tutorial about Delaware State University.
Visit dsuonline.instructure.com and use your University email address to sign on
Click the Community Tab on the top right
Under My Organizations select Virtual New Student Orientation
Select Virtual New Student Orientation Videos in the left panel
Select NSO Videos, then click Welcome Message to begin Orientation
Canvas coming soon for Summer 2026
Need to reach us?
For questions regarding orientation, please contact Graduate Studies and Research at gradstudieswilm [at] desu.edu.
For admissions inquiries, please contact our Graduate Admissions office at gradstudieswilm [at] desu.edu.
